tagline: Childcare, wherever you need it. Verified daycares and preschools, starting in Gurugram.
cta_body: Kribble's team visits and checks every daycare and preschool before it is listed. Compare fees and plans side by side, book a single day or a full year, and get updates from your child's centre in one app. Starting in Gurugram, other cities next.
blog_title: Childcare guides for Indian parents: daycare, preschool and Gurugram | Kribble
blog_description: Practical guides to choosing a daycare or preschool in India: checklists, fees, safety, settling in, and area-by-area guides to childcare in Gurugram.
blog_intro: Plain, practical guides for parents choosing a daycare, preschool or playschool, with honest checklists, fee explainers and area guides for Gurugram. Written by the team building Kribble.
llms_summary: Kribble is a childcare discovery and booking app for parents in India, launching first in Gurugram (Gurgaon). Its team physically visits and checks every daycare, preschool and playschool before listing it. Parents will be able to compare fees, plans and facilities, book anything from a single day (One-Day Daycare) to a full year, pay in the app and get daily updates from the centre. Kribble is pre-launch; parents can join the waitlist at kribblecare.com.
